rows.limitation: Signal needs complete adapter qualification and two-identity exact-build proof before OSL may claim protected Signal support.
rows.support_boundary: Signal has QA foundations only; OSL must refuse support claims until a complete adapter contract and two-peer exact-build proof exist.

rows.limitation: WhatsApp needs current adapter qualification and two-identity exact-build proof before OSL may claim protected WhatsApp support.
rows.support_boundary: WhatsApp needs its own runtime proof; OSL must refuse support claims until a complete adapter contract and two-peer exact-build proof exist.

rows.limitation: Telegram cannot be listed as supported until the signed-client row probe proves stable, text-exposed conversation rows.
rows.support_boundary: Telegram Desktop cannot be listed as supported until a signed-client UI Automation probe proves stable, text-exposed message rows on an actual conversation surface.

rows.limitation: OSL Mail for Outlook-connected mailboxes needs mailbox binding, recipient authority, draft handling, safe send behavior, and runtime proof before protected replies may be claimed.
rows.support_boundary: Outlook is scoped as OSL Mail, not Outlook chat support; protected inline replies must refuse until a separate OSL Mail gate proves mailbox binding, recipient authority, safe send behavior, draft handling, and runtime support.
